subject: Best digging there is
body:
Now that you're down there, start digging! Cavaryn is the best place for titanium and uranium, it's all through the broodstone.

The thing is the whole place is crawling with bugs and most of them want to eat you. If you stand around too long or go smashing eggs you'll wake up the hive. And you know I'm not coming down there to get you.

Your old friend,
Dr. T
